title: 第11章 资质一般厉行天
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
清晨。

    楚星尘拿着系统图纸仔细比对，勘测地区，然后插下一根小小的树枝作为标记。

    虽然不能凭空变出东西，但这图纸也有好处，那就是可以重复使用。

    毕竟还得自己去建，还是一次性的道具的话也太过坑爹了。

    这代表着或许可以先在十里坡先建上一个聚灵阵法。

    毕竟这十里坡不是灵气汇聚之地，也无灵脉走向，灵气虽然也有，但自然也比不上一些灵脉汇聚之地。

    简单来说，并不算是一个修仙的好地方。

    在同情况的修炼下，自然是灵脉汇聚之地修炼效果更好。

    所以大部分说的过去的仙家宗门都会挑上一个灵脉盘踞的山头建立宗门。

    以前李应灵修炼的时候，楚星尘都是拿灵石粗略建个法阵，供李应灵修炼。

    一个人尚可，现在多了个厉行天，这种败家行为自然得停下。

    单单供李应灵修炼都快把自己练的穷了，现在多个厉行天，要还是继续这样做灵石储备明显不够了。

    细水长流才是方案。

    建造聚灵法阵还是很有必要的，以后收徒也会更为方便一些。

    虽然目前手头的材料还不能搭建完成聚灵法阵。

    但还是可以进行一些基础动工。

    楚星尘又找准范围，插下一根树枝。

    轰！！

    远处激荡的风浪传来，接着就是泥土飞扬而起，朝四周飞散而去。

    楚星尘没好气挥手将风浪轰走，连忙向前两步。

    目光看向手持木剑努力轰着大坑的李应灵。

    李应灵已是筑基期，灵气护体还是毫无问题，所以也不会有泥土在弄脏她的衣服。

    此刻她手持木剑，神色认真地不断用神通轰击地面。

    又是一道猛烈的剑气撞击地面，巨响传来的同时又是激烈的震荡。

    楚星尘连忙抬手阻止：“等等！”

    听到师父呼唤，李应灵停下动作，神色疑惑的看向自家师父：

    “师父怎么了？”

    “不是，有你这样挖坑的吗？”

    李应灵十分不解：“不这样挖怎么挖？”

    楚星尘没好气道：“等下埋下阵基后面泥土还得回填，你这样轰的到处都是，拿什么回填？拿你的小脑袋吗？”
content_en:
early morning.

    Chu Xingchen compared the system drawings carefully, surveyed the area, and then inserted a small branch as a mark.

    Although you can't conjure things out of thin air, this drawing also has the advantage that it can be reused.

    After all, you have to build it yourself, and it would be too cheating if it were a one-time prop.

    This means that it may be possible to build a spirit gathering formation on Shilipo first.

    After all, this ten-mile slope is not a place where spiritual energy gathers, and there is no direction of spiritual veins. Although there is spiritual energy, it is naturally not as good as some places where spiritual energy gathers.

    To put it simply, it is not a good place to cultivate immortality.

    Under the same training conditions, the training effect will naturally be better in the place where spiritual veins gather.

    Therefore, most of the immortal sects in the past would choose a mountain top with spiritual veins to establish their sect.

    In the past, when Li Yingling was practicing, Chu Xingchen would use spiritual stones to roughly build a magic circle for Li Yingling to practice.

    One person is okay, but now that Li Xingtian is here, this kind of prodigal behavior must naturally stop.

    Just for Li Yingling to practice, he was almost exhausted. Now that there are several Li Xingtians, if he continues to do this, his spiritual stone reserve is obviously not enough.

    Slow and steady flow is the solution.

    It is still necessary to build the spirit gathering array, and it will be more convenient to recruit disciples in the future.

    Although the materials currently on hand cannot yet be used to build the spirit gathering array.

    But some basic work can still be done.

    Chu Xingchen found the area again and inserted a branch.

    boom! !

    The turbulent wind and waves in the distance came, and then the soil flew up and scattered in all directions.

    Angrily, Chu Xingchen waved away the wind and waves and quickly took two steps forward.

    He looked at Li Yingling who was holding a wooden sword and trying hard to blast the big hole.

    Li Yingling was already in the foundation building stage, and her spiritual energy protection was still no problem, so there was no mud soiling her clothes.

    At this moment, she was holding a wooden sword, with a serious expression on her face, and was constantly bombarding the ground with her magical power.

    Another violent sword energy hit the ground, and the loud noise was accompanied by fierce vibrations.

    Chu Xingchen quickly raised his hand to stop: "Wait!"

    Hearing his master's call, Li Yingling stopped and looked at his master with a puzzled expression:

    "What's wrong, Master?"

    "No, is there anyone who digs holes like you?"

    Li Yingling was very puzzled: "How can we dig if we don't dig like this?"

    Chu Xingchen said angrily: "The soil behind the formation base needs to be backfilled later. If you blast it everywhere like this, what can you use to backfill it? With your little head?"
